kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Uncertain. Al-Maqrizi derives it from Classical Syriac ܓܸܣܵܐ (gessā, “side”). Peust suggests a Persian etymology from Persian دز (dez, “castle”). Everett-Heath suggests an Egyptian etymology from Egyptian r-gs-ḥr (“on the side of the high one (pyramid)”).
s: Egyptian r-gs-ḥr (“on the side of the high one (pyramid)”)
g: Giza (a city, the capital city of Giza governorate, Egypt)
